fields.description: Talay Beach is the 184-home villa collection closer to the shoreline at Marsa Al Saadiyat. Four-, five- and six-bedroom homes have their own floor and plot specifications, distinct from the neighbouring Talay release.

overview: Marsa Al Saadiyat is planned around a waterfront setting with beaches, a marina, cultural destinations and interconnected walking routes. Talay Beach belongs to this larger destination. Planned district facilities should be assessed separately from the amenities delivered with an individual villa.
research.locationNote: Aldar positions Talay Beach closer to the beach than Talay. Proximity alone does not establish that every villa is beachfront or includes private beach rights.
research.priceNote: Property Finder lists AED 14m for Talay Beach. The shared fact sheet's AED 13.5m headline is not a verified Beach-specific quote. Obtain a current price list and available plot details.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 50% during construction and 50% at handover. No confirmed Beach-specific booking instalment or dated schedule was found; Talay's dates have not been reused.
research.handoverNote: The phase-labelled fact sheet estimates handovers commencing Q4 2030 for Talay Beach; Property Finder states December 2030. Both are estimates requiring confirmation for the selected villa.
